title: someone starts something without opening a shop

criteria.text: A Member with no Page can create a hosted gathering: no business record, no document, ID or ZIP check; the F082 rules agreement is the only thing before publish
criteria.note: Create (`/create`) calls `startDraftAction` -> `group.create` with kind from the purpose, no `group_businesses` row and no ID or ZIP field; `group.activate` needs a name, where it is, a description and the agreed-rules version [V src/app/create/actions.ts, actions/group/activate.ts]. The agreement is now the one line 'By posting you agree to the Terms' (#1135), not a rules step; `RULES_VERSION = 1` is still sent. Built by #326 (Reviewed by) and #364 (review-skipped). Checked: no `[guards F060.1]` marker exists anywhere; `create/actions.test.ts` carries only an F082.6 marker (#580, #581). Shipped: Deploy health green on a5eefa3, c006495 and 3df9260. Smoked: no smoke route for /create or the publish card [V evals/screens/routes.ts]

criteria.text: Create's first question is what they're starting, not what they are; no self-classification anywhere in the flow
criteria.note: `/create` heading 'What are you starting?' with four answers (sell, gather, offer, Be creative) and 'This just gets things started' [V WhatAreYouStarting.tsx]. The answers are questions about the thing, worded by Don 2026-10-04 and 2026-10-05, newer than this criterion (F061 Rulings); its `/you/create` path is stale, the route is `/create`. Entry is now the one + menu's 'Start a Page' (#1095). Built by #326, #364, #382 (the last two review-skipped). Checked: unmarked `WhatAreYouStarting.test.tsx`; nothing guards 'no self-classification' in Create's copy (#580, #581). Smoked: no smoke route for /create

criteria.text: Page creation shows no legal or tax language and asks for no legal-entity information
criteria.note: No legal, tax, licence or entity words in Create, the publish checklist or the Terms line; no field asks for entity information [V grep src/components/create, src/app/create]. Built by #326 (Reviewed by) and #364 (review-skipped). #1135 removed the rules block and with it the only scan (F082.5), so nothing guards it for Create now (#581). Shipped: green on a5eefa3, c006495, 3df9260. Smoked: no smoke route for /create

criteria.text: Starting a second Page is one tap from the end of the first, and leaves the first unchanged
criteria.note: Spec conflict, not a build gap. The criterion says 'one tap'. Since #1095 (Don, 2026-11-01: 'one + and a You avatar replace the bottom tab bar') a second Page is the + then 'Start a Page' then the kind, two taps to the question where the old Create tab was one [V CreateMenu.tsx, create-targets.ts]; no ruling in this scenario says whether a menu item counts. `group.create` still inserts only a new draft row, so the first Page is unchanged [V]. Built by #58 (no `Reviewed by:`, no Deploy health run on f79dd46) and #1095 (`Reviewed by: pending`). Routed to `scope-scenario`: restate 'one tap' as the + menu, or ask Don.

criteria.text: `/you/sell` redirects to Create, preserving any query string
criteria.note: `/you/sell/page.tsx` is still `redirect('/create')` and drops the query string, so a link's `?compose=gathering&location=...` is lost [V]. The criterion's `/you/create` target is stale; the route is `/create` (#301) and #579 keeps that target. The redirect half came with #392 (review-skipped); the query-string half is not built and no test asserts the redirect (#579). Held, not cancelled, by the 11-06 build freeze (unbuilt criteria of the Now lane).
